model: frozen stage87 direct62 calibrated predictions, reused from stage126; zero new fits/forwards
selection: Original In Faser Nu Box or Lead Block AND common cuboid; only replace truth-radius cut; all other cuts fixed; pz100 primary and pz50 secondary
selection_roles: reuse stage126 evaluation_role exactly; no test-driven boundary refinement
objective: Cal-only Pareto curve: maximize record yield at allowed log-RMSE ratio to r100 1.01/1.03/1.05 and tail50 increase<=2 pp; paired500 incoming CI on fixed shortlist; largest N tie smallest area then shortest center displacement. Also report maximum N/log-MSE as a named heuristic, not physical Fisher information. No automatic production replacement.
shortlist: For each budget, up to12 Pareto candidates ranked by count then area plus minimum-RMSE and maximum N/log-MSE candidates. Exact cal CIs select finalists; evaluate only fixed finalists on test. cal CI is post-selection and conditional, not simultaneous/source/systematic coverage.
units: positions mm, dimensions mm, energy GeV; errors dimensionless
limits: Nominal MC exploratory selection study; no physical flux/background/systematic normalization. Keep both material z regions; no optimization of z/material mixture.
denominators: Read native truth parent before reco cuts; exact stage126 parent50 closure per source. Store 2D count histograms at strict-boundary edges; report Nfinal/Ntruth-inside and common-parent acceptance separately, all records only.
